row.evidence: Workable's SSO overview says SSO is "Included as part of Premier and Enterprise plans" and users are created on first SAML sign-in; no SCIM endpoint is documented in the help centre or API reference, and the Okta OIN app supports SAML and SWA only.
row.notes: Status changed from June (gated) to none. June's 'SCIM-style directory sync is Enterprise-tier' has no first-party source: help-centre searches for scim, provisioning and directory sync return no SCIM article, the API reference index (workable.readme.io/llms.txt) has no SCIM resource, Okta's Workable app is SAML+SWA only and Microsoft's Entra tutorial is SAML SSO with JIT. Automation is SAML JIT (new members created on first SSO sign-in with limited access), auto-join by email domain, and the REST API (/spi/v3/members: list, invite, update, deactivate, restore) which the pricing page lists as 'API access' on all plans. Prices are flat monthly bands by employee count (shown for the 1-20 employee band: Standard $299, Premier $599, Enterprise $719 per month billed annually; annual saves 20%), so per-user fields are null. SAML SSO is Premier and Enterprise (crossed out on Standard; June said add-on for Standard, no source found).

scim.notes: Not documented anywhere searched (see searched); set false by absence.

webhooks_user_events.notes: Webhook subscriptions cover candidates and employees (c27), not account members.

limitations.text: API tokens expire (30 days to 2 years) and are generated by Admin users.

okta.notes: OIN page markup marks SAML and SWA as checked; SCIM/Create/Deactivate unchecked.

entra.notes: Gallery SAML app; provisioning is just-in-time on sign-in.

google.notes: Custom SAML app in Google Admin.

onelogin.notes: From Workable's OneLogin guide (SAML2.0 connector); OneLogin page not loaded.

fallbacks.other_sync: Auto-join by company email domain; REST API member invite/deactivate
